day_local: Khamiis Todobaadka Soddomaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Aamiin. Nabad iyo nimco ha idinla joogaan inta aad halkan ku soo ururtay si aad u wadaagto kelmedda iyo ducooyinka Rabbiga.

psalm_response: Barakaysan ha ahaado Rabbiga, Dhagaxayga adag!
homily:
Bal ka fikir habeen ay dabayshu xoog ku heyso daaqadaha, oo aad maqasho dhawaaqa wax culus oo ku dhacaya dibedda. Waa habeen qof walba uu ku xirto albaabkiisa, oo uu raadsado meel uu ku dhuunto. Laakiin quraanka iyo akhriska maanta ee uu rasuul Bawlos u qoray reer Efesos ma keenayo inaan dhulka ku gurguurno cabsi darteed; wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan xidhno hubka Ilaah. Wuxuu leeyahay: 'Xidha hubka Ilaah, si aad awood ugu yeerataan inaad adkaataan munaasabadda sharka.' Wuxuu ka hadlayaa suunka runta, hubeedka xaqnimada, kabaha nabadda, iyo gaashaanweynaha rumaysadka. Wuxuu tilmaamayaa in dagaalkeennu uusan ahayn mid hilib iyo dhiig ah, ee uu yahay mid u dhexeeya nuurka iyo mugdiga.

Hal sawir ayaan rabaa inaan maanta maskaxda ku hayno: waa kabaha taagan ee diyaaraddu ku socoto dusha sare ee runway-ga, iyada oo isku diyaarinaysa inay hawada gasho, iyada oo aan ka cabsanayn dhibta iyo culuska hawada. Benjamin Vo wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel diyaaradaha, wiil maskaxdiisa iyo qalbigiisuba ay ku xirnaayeen cirka. Waxaad og tihiin sida uu ugu farxi jiray markii uu ka hadlayay 'con chim airlines', shirkaddaas yar ee uu maskaxdiisa ku abuuray, taas oo keeni jirtay dhoola caddayn iyo qosol jilicsan marka uu ka sheekaynayey. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil indhihiisu ay eegayeen meel ka sarraysa dhibaatooyinka dunidan. Hilib iyo dhiig ma ahayn waxa kaliya ee noloshiisu ay ahayd; waxay ahayd safar dheer oo uu ku gaarayo meel ka sarraysa daruuraha.

Laakiin, aan marka hore runta si daacad ah u wajahno intaanan halkaas sii marin. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus oo aan la qiyaasi karin. Waxaa jira subaxyo marka aad kacdaan oo aad dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid qabow, oo ay adag tahay in la neefsado. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad dib u eegtaan wax walba oo dhacay, idinkoo is weydiinaya haddii aad wax ka bedeli karseen. Fadlan, halkan istaaga oo dhageysta tan: xanuunkan iyo dhibaatadan midkoodna ma aha khaladkiinna. Sida Ciise uu mar u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, ‘Neither this man nor his parents.’ Xanuunkan iyo cudurkan midkoodna ma aha wax idinka yimid; ma jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna wuxuu ahaa mid dhab ah oo aan xad lahayn. Ha is-eedeynin, hana qaadin culeys uusan Ilaah idin saarin.

Oo halkaas, bartamaha mugdiga iyo xanuunka, waxaa soo galaya Injiilka maanta oo noo sheegaya jawaabta Ciise uu u celiyay Farisiiyiinta ku yiri Herodos wuxuu doonayaa wuxuu dilo. Ciise wuxuu leeyahay: ‘Tag oo u sheeg dawaco taas, Bal eeg, waxaan saarayaa jinniyada, waxaan bogsiiyaa maanta iyo berrito, oo maalinta saddexaadna waan dhammaystirayaa ujeeddadayda.’ Ciise kama cabsanayo Herodos. Kama cabsanayo dhimashada. Wuxuu leeyahay waxaa jira meel loo socdo, oo waxaa jira ujeeddo weyn oo fulaysa. Oo markaas ayuu ku qaylinayaa magaalada Yeruusaalem isagoo leh sidii hooyo baalasha hoostooda ku ururisa ilmaheeda: ‘Yeruusaalem, Yeruusaalem… imisa jeer baan rabay inaan ururiyo carruurtaada sidii digaaggu baalashiisa hoostooda ugu ururiyo dugsigiisa, laakiin idinku ma aydin doonin!’

Bal u fiirso sawirkaas hooyada digaagga ah ee baalasha hoostooda gelinaysa ilmaheeda. Waa nabad. Waa meel diiran oo aan halis ka jirin. Ben wuxuu hadda ku jiraa baalashaas nabadda ah. Sida uu ku yiri riyadii uu la wadaagay qoyskiisa, ‘Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết. Con tự thở được bình thường mà…’ Wuxuu gudbay imtixaankii nolosha si kaamil ah. Wuxuu hadda joogaa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo nabad qaba.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro wadnahaaga. Xusuuso riyooyinkii aad wadaagteen, iyo jacaylka aan dhimanayn ee idin mideeya. Ha ka baqina inaad horay u socoto, oo aad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee Ben uu mar walba ka helayay inuu arko.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha, halkaas oo uu ka ilaalinayo qoyskiisa. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciiseow gowsaygu waa og yahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sakramenta Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclaa wax kasta, waxaanan jeclaan lahaa inaan kugu soo biiriyo naftayda. Maaddaama aanan hadda heli karin Sakramenta, fadlan ku soo gal naftayda si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kuu duubayaa naftayda oo dhan, hana ogolaanin inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin haysto; Rabbigu ha u jeediyo wajigiisa dhankiinna, oo ha idin siiyo nabad maanta iyo weligiisba. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkayagii qaali ahaa ee Benjamin Vo, iyo dhammaan kuwii naga tegey, in lagu xisaabiyo iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiix, oo ay ku nastaan Banquet of Heaven, aan tukano.

Dhammaan qoysaska iyo waalidiinta culus ee dhibaatadu haysato, gaar ahaan Alan iyo Thao iyo Ryan, iyo dhammaan carruurta xanuunsan ee dunida ku dhibtoonaya, in Ilaah siiyo xoog, rajo, iyo qalbi qaboojin, aan tukano.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalaheyow, xoogkiinna ka hel Rabbiga iyo awooddiisa weyn. Xidha hubka Ilaah, si aad awood ugu yeerataan inaad adkaataan munaasabadda sharka ee Shaydaanka. Waayo dagaalkeennu ma aha mid aan la dagaallamayno hilib iyo dhiig, ee waa mid aan la dagaallamayno madaxda, iyo kuwa awoodda leh, iyo taliyayaasha adduunkan mugdiga ah, iyo ruuxyada sharka ah ee meelaha sare ku jira. Sida daraaddeed xidha hubka Ilaah, si aad u adkaataan maalinta sharka ah, oo markaad wax walba sameyseen kadib, aad istaagtaan. Haddaba adkaada, idinkoo dhexda ku xidhan runta, oo xidhan gaashaanka laabta ee xaqnimada, oo cagtiinna ku xidhan diyaarinta Injiilka nabadda. Xaalad walba qaata gaashaanweynaha rumaysadka, kaas oo aad ku demin kartaan fallaadhaha dabka ah ee sharka leh. Oo qaata koofiyadda badbaadada, iyo seefaha Ruuxa, oo ah kelmedda Ilaah. Salaad iyo duco kasta ku tukada Ruuxa mar kasta. Arrintaas awgeed u foojignaada dulqaadasho oo dhan iyo duco ay u duceeyaan dhammaan quduusiinta iyo aniga qudhayda, in hadal la i siiyo markaan afkayga furo, si aan geesinimo ugu ogeysiiyo sirta Injiilka, kaas oo aan safiir ugu ahay silsiladaha, si aan geesinimo ugu hadlo sida ay tahay inaan u hadlo.

Barakaysan ha ahaado Rabbiga, dhagaxayga, kan gacmahayga u tababara dagaal, iyo farahayga dagaal.
R. Barakaysan ha ahaado Rabbiga, Dhagaxayga adag!
Naxariistayda iyo qalcadayda, dhuumashadayda iyo badbaadiyahayga, gaashaanayga oo aan ku kalsoonahay, kan dadkayga hoosta iga gelinaya.
R. Barakaysan ha ahaado Rabbiga, Dhagaxayga adag!
Ilaahow, hees cusub baan kuu heesi doonaa; shabag toban xadhig leh baan ku ammaani doonaa adiga oo siiya guul boqorrada, oo ka badbaadiya addoonkaaga Daawo seefaha sharka ah.
R. Barakaysan ha ahaado Rabbiga, Dhagaxayga adag!

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Saacaddaas waxaa yimid Faarisiiyiin qaar oo ku yiri: ‘Ka bax meeshan oo tag, waayo Herodos wuxuu doonayaa inuu ku dilo.’ Markaasuu ku yiri: ‘Tag oo u sheeg dawaco taas: Bal eeg, waxaan saarayaa jinniyada, waxaan bogsiiyaa maanta iyo berrito, oo maalinta saddexaadna waan dhammaystirayaa ujeeddadayda. Hase yeeshee waa inaan socdaa maanta, iyo berrito, iyo maalinta xigtana, waayo ma aha in Nebi uu ka dhinto meel ka baxsan Yeruusaalem. Yeruusaalem, Yeruusaalem, adoo dila nabiyada oo dhagaxa ku dhufta kuwa laguu soo diray, imisa jeer baan rabay inaan ururiyo carruurtaada sidii digaaggu baalashiisa hoostooda ugu ururiyo dugsigiisa, laakiin idinku ma aydin doonin! Bal eeg, gurigiina waa laga tegi doonaa. Waxaan idinku leeyahay, ima arki doontaan ilaa waqtigu yimaado markaad tihiin: “Barakaysan yahay kan ku yimid magaca Rabbiga.”’

day: Thursday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
